S.FORM: alang Mananigay ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Kingbong go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 34 buwan, 116 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 98% kyan ku 114 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 2% kyan ku 2 hi nya. rhzyal kki'an lingay na Mananigay ga Tudrivuan ru Laliavan. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Mananigay ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Mananigay ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ mananiɣaj ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu kiŋβoŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja rħzjal kkiʔan liŋaj na mananiɣaj ɣa tu*ri*uan ru lalia*an reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ mananiɣaj ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ mananiɣaj ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
